geography_label: Retrospectively harmonised current organisation footprint; merger mapping uses later information

gate.rule: Beat both baselines on paired issue-anchor MAE and MASE at 8 AND 12 weeks.
gate.caveat: Selection uses this retrospective comparison; it is not independent confirmation or a clinical deployment approval.

growth_display.rule: Raw classifier >=0.6 plus rising point forecast: up; <=0.4 plus falling point: down; else unclear.
growth_display.caveat: Experimental categories, not validated probabilities; thresholds are assumptions.

national_model_forecasts.reason: Only paired cohort sums have been evaluated; full England coverage and aggregate intervals are not established. No national model forecasts exported.
